# Docling scanned figure caption

p9-iterator.json is a bounded excerpt from one English Tesseract PSM 11
read of page 9 of the public test corpus PDF pdf_scanned/docling_scanned.pdf
(SHA-256 874bada67b7bf700d42df25265823799955ae37ba3ec0e283747d1f2cd5d94f7).
The processed image is 2586 × 3346. The excerpt holds the caption grid
and six iterator lines with their 85 words in literal order. Public
hierarchy IDs were removed so the proof must establish unique geometry
and ownership from the original line and word records.

The matching digital PDF pdf/docling.pdf independently locates and spells
the Figure 4 caption. No raster or alternate OCR text is included.
